For Solasta II Early Access build **CL-112340**.

**New in 1.1 — the inspection screen (inventory / character sheet / spells) now handles six heroes:**
- portraits 5 and 6 appear in the top-left strip, showing the right faces,
- the selection ring follows onto them,
- clicking them switches hero (Tab already worked),
- the multiplayer lobby's six seats are laid out as 3x2 instead of overflowing off-screen.

Everything from 1.0 is unchanged: up to 6 heroes in a new campaign and up to 6 players in a hosted lobby, with existing 4-hero saves untouched.

**Install:** unzip, close the game, run `BiggerParty-Installer.exe` (installs UE4SS if needed), start the game. Everyone in a session installs the same way. `u` in the installer uninstalls.

**Verified:** 6-hero single-player campaign (creation, party, HUD, combat, save/load), 6-seat lobby, and the six-portrait inspection strip. **Not yet verified:** a full 6-player online session — reports welcome in Issues.

After a game patch the mod refuses to touch code it doesn't recognise and goes inert (see `BiggerParty.log`); your saves are safe either way.
